items: 【𝗦𝗶𝘇𝗲 & 𝗣𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿】Please measure your outdoor furniture first for a perfect fit. Our patio furniture cushions are vacuum-packed for shipping and will expand to full 4" thickness within 48-72 hours. Due to natural fabric properties, slight color variations may occur under different lighting or screens

【𝟰-𝗽𝗶𝗲𝗰𝗲 𝗢𝘂𝘁𝗱𝗼𝗼𝗿 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗦𝗲𝘁】This 4-piece set includes 2 seat cushions (22.5'' x 20.5'' x 4'') and 2 backrest cushions (21.6'' x 18.5'' x 8''). Specially designed for 4-seater patio furniture, perfect for lounging, entertaining, or relaxing by the pool

【𝟰" 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗸 𝗣𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀】4-inch 24D high-density foam cushion provides excellent support without collapse. The backrest cushion is filled with fluffy PP cotton, providing cloud like comfort for long-term outdoor relaxation

【𝗪𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿-𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗣𝗼𝗹𝘆𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗙𝗮𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗰】The outdoor couch cushions Crafted with heavy-duty polyester fabric, our cushions resist fading, water, and UV damage—ideal for decks, gardens, or poolside use. Perfect for enhancing various terrace sofas, such as willow branches, metal outdoor furniture sets, etc

【𝗡𝗼𝗻-𝗦𝗹𝗶𝗽 & 𝗘𝗮𝘀𝘆 𝗠𝗮𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲】Features non-slip silicone dot to keep outdoor sofa cushions securely in place, while sturdy olive-shaped button straps lock cushions securely to furniture, even in windy conditions. The machine washable cushion cover is equipped with a reinforced zipper for easy cleaning
